caveats: Thresholds/climatology per sea cell from baseline 1992-2002 with +/-5-day day-of-year windows (pools of 121 values incl. margin days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05); 90th percentile via Hazen rule; 31-day circular smoothing; day-of-year 60 interpolated from 59 and 61. 3302 of 3600 region cells are sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days). No NaNs in sea-cell baseline values.
